description: This file defines the AddJobVacancyController class within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a Vue component named 'add-job-vacancy' in the preRender method. It appears to be part of the backend code that interacts with the frontend component for adding job vacancies.
